author: reek
body: Adversarial probe (ProofTotalityProbe Stage 2, positive proof-term grammar). The body of a proof-typed definition is a plain when- expression. A proof recurses only through 'induction', which discharges subgoals against inductive hypotheses; a bare 'when' is case analysis with no hypothesis and is not a proof term. No name cycle, so Stage 1 (CDX4023) passes it; the positive grammar (CDX4024) rejects the form. This is what distinguishes the allowed 'induction' expression from a disallowed 'when' at a proof position.
